description: Browse the demo's draft Swiss tax entries before you ask. Free. Each entry was drafted by AI and has been validated by no professional; in the pilot, entries will be validated by a named Treuhänder before they are served. Returns, for each matching entry, the canonical question, its assumptions and the intake fields it matches on. The entry itself comes back only from `ask`, and only when your principal's fields match it. Use it to see which topics exist, or which facts decide an answer, before you collect them.

keywords.description: Plain words; every word must appear in the entry's question or category.

name: search_library
